answer.text: Total overdue AR is about NZD 10.17 million. AU-EAST is highest at NZD 3.58m, then NZ-NORTH at 3.08m, AU-WEST at 1.79m and NZ-SOUTH at 1.71m.
assumptions: No time range applied: all outstanding invoices past their due date
Amounts in NZD (AUD converted at the monthly rate)

sql.sql:
select i.region as region, round(sum(i.outstanding_nzd) filter (where i.days_overdue > 0), 2) as ar_overdue_amount
from marts.fct_invoices as i
group by 1
order by 2 desc nulls last
limit %(row_limit)s
